meta.what: wallpaper-head-v3 gate-passer set — the population the render-mode (mining) corpus samplers draw from: one row per (location, palette) whose stored 1280x720 crop the deployed wallpaper head scores above the emission gate.
meta.replaces: scratchpad/gate_passers_v3.json (disposable tree; lost in the derived-artifact wipe — scratch/stage2_label_audit/report.md)
meta.source_probe: the batch's OWN stored crops/<image_id>.jpg (1280x720 ss2 lanczos3) — NOT a re-render: the July gate was applied to these exact JPGs, and re-rendering would move the boundary under today's colour tail

gate.statistic: marginal p_ge3 = cumprod(sigmoid(logits))[1] (NEVER the CORN conditional)

meta.deploy_transform: classifier.data.Transform(train=False) — 1280x720 -> 384x224 bicubic stretch + normalize (present.rs's JPG path)
meta.precision: fp32, no autocast. MEASURED: the same 1000 crops under torch.autocast give 403 passers, not 401 — two rows sit close enough to p_ge3 == 0.90 that fp16 accumulation moves them across the gate. A cut needs full precision; a ranking does not.

verified_against_census.census_source: tools/render_mode_pilot/build_sample.py header ('gate-passers (401 rows)') and build_scale_sample.py docstring ('the 112 v3-gate-passer locations')
verified_against_census.note: the two counts the July samplers printed about the file they read, recorded while the old path still worked

library_records_not_used.why: the audit's suggested fallback, and a DIFFERENT population — 47 curated fresh-discovery locations from a later era, whose 12 palette candidates carry no v3 gate score. Unioning it in would have broadened the draw across two eras; the July design is one population, and this source reproduces it exactly. Decision 2026-08-06, Matt.
